title: Mystic Sorceress in Enchanted Grove
description: A barefoot woman in a flowing dark blue and purple robe stands in a mystical forest clearing, arms outstretched with glowing magic emanating from her hands. White butterflies, black birds, glowing fish, and ethereal mist swirl around her beneath a crescent moon and colorful nebula sky.
prompt: A mystical woman with long dark hair wearing a flowing dark blue and purple starry robe stands barefoot in an enchanted forest clearing at night, arms outstretched releasing magic, glowing white butterflies and black ravens flying around her, colorful nebula and crescent moon in the sky, glowing fish swimming through mist, bioluminescent flowers and trees with hanging crystals, magical atmosphere, detailed fantasy digital art
